246.text: "It will cost us some resources in the short term, but gain us a considerable amount of income that we'll be able to reinvest into other sectors."

257.text: "We don't have to nationalize the company by force. We can buy our way to a stakeholder majority."

261.speaker: Elena Werner

266.speaker: Elena Werner

268.speaker: Elena Werner
268.text: "If we decide to imprison Rusty Montoro, a government takeover of the company will be relatively easy."

272.speaker: Elena Werner
272.text: "If it comes to that, I will have the documents ready."

276.speaker: Player_Romus
276.text: "A little overeager, aren't you? I haven't even spoken to Rusty about all this yet."

281.text: "There is one economic factor we have not discussed yet. Rizian Royal Gold."

317.text: "Then again, if your goal is to keep the left-wingers in the RPP from causing a stir, taking Rizia's most renowned corporation out of private hands might do the trick. For a while."

318.speaker: Player_Romus
318.text: "I have the feeling Soletato's people will not be appeased that easily."

319.speaker: Player_Romus
319.text: "Sotelato is a former miner, isn't he? It'll make him happy to see his ex-boss lose everything."

320.speaker: Player_Romus

322.text: "Yes, and there are other ways to deal with Sotelato."

324.text: "Father. Do you really think the reformists are that petty?"

384.text: "Of course not. It's a terrible idea."

385.speaker: Player_Romus
385.text: "Why not? He could make us a lot of money."

386.speaker: Player_Romus
386.text: "I never much liked the idea of gambling with our kingdom's finances."

387.speaker: Player_Romus
387.text: "It's high time we established such a draw for investors. But I'm not sold on the idea of Rusty heading it."

388.speaker: Elena Werner
388.text: "It can be someone else. But Mr. Montoro does have the right connections."

389.speaker: Elena Werner
389.text: "Nor do I. But I admit that if done right, this could open the door to a flood of international investment."

391.speaker: Elena Werner
391.text: "I have doubts about it myself, Your Majesty. But its proponents say it could open the door to a flood of international investment."

392.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
392.text: "If we established such an exchange, Rizia's economy would be tied to our global image more strongly than ever before."

396.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
396.text: "As it stands, we have the potential to win big."

398.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
398.text: "As it stands, we have to think carefully before taking that risk."

403.speaker: Elena Werner
403.text: "But we're getting off track. I'd like to know His Majesty's verdict on the wartime nationalization of RRG."

408.speaker: Player_Romus
408.text: "With the leverage we now have over him, he could make us a lot of money."

412.speaker: Player_Romus
412.text: "It's high time we established such a draw for investors. But I have other plans for Rusty."

413.speaker: Elena Werner
413.text: "Understood. It doesn't have to be him leading it."

418.speaker: Elena Werner
418.text: "Rusty Montoro's name was floated as a candidate to chair it. Obviously, that's not going to happen now. But the general idea still stands."

419.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
419.text: "If we established such an exchange, Rizia's economy would be tied to our global image more strongly than ever before."

423.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
423.text: "As it stands, we have the potential to win big."

425.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
425.text: "As it stands, we have to think carefully before taking that risk."

431.speaker: Elena Werner
431.text: "As you may have heard, I was talking to some business owners about the idea of forming a stock exchange in Porte Drazon."

436.speaker: Elena Werner
436.text: "I'm glad you took my advice to form the Porte Drazon Stock Exchange. Once it opens, our kingdom will finally be fully integrated into the global market."

440.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
440.text: "With all the diplomatic benefits that entails."

441.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
441.text: "With all the risks and perils that entails."

442.speaker: Elena Werner
442.text: "And I thought I'd let you know that Rusty Montoro's name has been floated as a candidate to chair it."

443.speaker: Hugo Toras
443.text: "You'd trust that man with the Rizian stock market?"

444.speaker: Player_Romus
444.text: "Of course not. It's a terrible idea."

445.speaker: Player_Romus
445.text: "Why not? He could make us a lot of money."

446.speaker: Player_Romus
446.text: "If our kingdom's finances are to be gambled with, I'd prefer you be the one rolling the dice."

447.speaker: Elena Werner
447.text: "That's very kind. But I admit that with Mr. Montoro's connections, he could open the door to a flood of international investment."

449.speaker: Elena Werner
449.text: "He's a known name in Arcasian circles, for better or worse. Appointing him could open the door to a flood of international investment."

453.speaker: Player_Romus
453.text: "With the leverage we now have over him, he could make us a lot of money."

457.speaker: Player_Romus
457.text: "Give Rusty a chance, Hugo. He's done more for Rizia than you know."

462.speaker: Elena Werner
462.text: "That is, if we don't nationalize his company."

467.speaker: Elena Werner
467.text: "Although of course there is the matter of his... allegiance."

468.speaker: Hugo Toras
468.text: "Ms. Werner, are you seriously suggesting handing our financial reins to a traitor for the sake of a few guilder?"

472.speaker: Player_Romus
472.text: "I have other plans for Rusty, Hugo. Don't worry."

473.speaker: Player_Romus
473.text: "Mr. Montoro's fate will be discussed shortly. I'll keep this information in mind."

474.speaker: Player_Romus
474.text: "Our treasury is shrinking. This is worth taking into consideration."

475.speaker: Elena Werner
475.text: "But it's your decision, Your Majesty. The appointment will be made a few months from now."

479.speaker: Player_Romus
479.text: "I agree with you, Hugo. This is absurd."

480.speaker: Elena Werner
480.text: "I would be happy to chair the exchange myself, Your Majesty. I'm just conveying business owners' opinion."

481.speaker: Player_Romus
481.text: "Not just a few. Long-lasting financial security for Rizia is finally within our grasp."

482.speaker: Player_Romus
482.text: "I'll decide for myself whether he's a traitor. Then we'll see."
